annotations.title: Hand a task to the agent

description: Hand a task to the user's personal agent. It lands as a note in the desk folder (pushed to the shared repository when the desk syncs through git) and the agent is notified by the doorbells that are configured (email, and optionally Telegram or Slack); the agent answers in the note. `notified` lists the doorbells that rang. If it is empty, nobody has been told yet: send ring's email by another route (for example a mail connector). Use for errands outside the computer, questions while the user is away, and status lines; never for building or code work. Never include passwords, codes or keys.
